top_signals.title: Ukraine Hits Ninth Russian Oil Refinery Since Start of November
top_signals.summary: Ukraine continued its campaign of near daily strikes on Russian oil assets, hitting a major refinery in the Volga region on Friday after the latest round of US-mediated peace talks between the two nations ended earlier this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: New Corporate Speak Is Shaped By AI
top_signals.summary: Corporate managements are using new euphemisms for job cuts or hiring freezes far more in the age of AI, as technology-enabled headcount reductions increasingly draw public ire and pushback from politicians, bloomberg Opinion columnist Jonathan Levin says. As a result, company leaders are leaning on vague talking points about “efficiency,” “automation” and, yes, “delayering.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
